note: Read 2026-11-03. Majority: 21. The French Civil Code of 1958, made applicable in Chad by the Acte législatif n°1 of 31 March 1959 and the Loi constitutionnelle n°2/62 of 16 April 1962, art. 488: majority is fixed at twenty-one completed years, and at that age one is capable of every act of civil life (art. 388: a minor is under twenty-one). Read in the Barreau du Tchad's edition (SCP-A&L, December 2014), held as a secondary source naming the Code; no later Chadian law lowering it was found, though none was searched beyond this. Work: null here; the person research's reading of the 1996 Labour Code (fourteen, a younger performer barred) is read in (tools/papers/ages/person.ts). Service: not read (the game doesn't read service).

sources.title: Code civil français de 1958 rendu applicable au Tchad par l'Acte législatif n°1 du 31 mars 1959 et la Loi constitutionnelle n°2/62 du 16 avril 1962 (Barreau du Tchad, SCP-A&L, éd. déc. 2014), art. 488
sources.said: Art. 488 (L. 2 février 1933, J.O. C., 1934, p. 42). – La majorité est fixée à vingt et un ans accomplis ; à cet âge, on est capable de tous les actes de la vie civile. [...] Art. 388. – Le mineur est l’individu de l’un et de l’autre sexe qui n’a point encore l’âge de vingt et un ans accomplis.
